method: All 1920 current records checked against the exact current bank and the preceding question-by-question, source-reviewed audit. 1907 answers/rationales are unchanged from that review; 13 research restorations freshly examined against their primary text. This continuation retains, rather than claims to repeat, the earlier full source audit. New evidence was assessed as doctrine-specific normative inference; no expected axis placements were consulted.

profiles.scopeAndEvidenceFinding: No answer or rationale changes from the prior independent review. Institutional gaps remain unknown; no unprovided doctrine is converted to neutral.

decisions.question: National leaders should need to win regular competitive elections to remain in office.
decisions.reviewReason: Unchanged from prior independent literal/source review.
decisions.answerRationale: Renewable electoral consent checks officeholders without granting them power to violate rights.
